## 1. Introduction

Supplier selection is a critical decision problem in the aviation industry due to
high safety, quality, and reliability requirements.  
This study proposes an integrated **AHP + Monte Carlo simulation** framework
to evaluate supplier alternatives under uncertainty.

## 2. Methodology

### 2.1 Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP)

AHP is used to derive the relative importance (weights) of the evaluation criteria
based on expert judgments.

### 2.2 Monte Carlo Simulation

Monte Carlo simulation is applied to model uncertainty in both:
- criteria weights
- supplier performance scores

A Dirichlet distribution is used for weights, while triangular distributions
are used for supplier scores.

## 3. Case Study: Aviation Supplier Selection

The proposed method is applied to an aviation supplier selection problem
with four alternative suppliers.
